name: Hand-off: she needs no stairs
body: She got stuck on the stairs. She crouches, you jump from her back, you pull the lever that lowers her stair, and she walks up it by beats (never by following your trail up the high steps).

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: She never follows your trail up the steps
She reaches the plate and holds the final door
